name: A Tale of Two Cities
equipment: A copy of the book (public domain -- free from Project Gutenberg or Standard Ebooks)
instructions: A Tale of Two Cities was written by Charles Dickens, first published in 1859.
Set in London and Paris before and during the French Revolution -- opens with the famous line "It was the best of times, it was the worst of times."
Discussion prompt: Revolution is one of the novel's central threads -- note a passage where you saw it most clearly.
